/*
	Sửa giờ NCKH
*/
ALTER proc [dbo].[SIM_TeachingTimeResearch_Update]
(
	@TeachingTimeResearchID bigint,
	@TeacherID nvarchar(200),
	@YearID int,
	@Semester int,
	@TeachHour decimal(18,2) = null,
	@ResearchHour decimal(18,2) = null,
	@SavePrev decimal(18,2) = null,
	@ResearchNow decimal(18,2) = null,
	@ResearchContent nvarchar(max) = null,
	@DecisionNo nvarchar(500) = null,
	@UpdatedUser nvarchar(50) = null
)
AS
Begin

	Declare @decTotalHour decimal(18,2)
	Declare @decSaveNext decimal(18,2)
	Declare @decLackHour decimal(18,2)

	Set @decTotalHour = isnull(@SavePrev, 0) + isnull(@ResearchNow, 0)

	If @decTotalHour >= isnull(@ResearchHour, 0)
	Begin
		Set @decSaveNext = @decTotalHour - isnull(@ResearchHour, 0)
		Set @decLackHour = 0
	End
	Else
	Begin
		Set @decSaveNext = 0
		Set @decLackHour = isnull(@ResearchHour, 0) - @decTotalHour
	End

	Update SIM_TeachingTimeResearch
	Set
		TeacherID = @TeacherID,
		YearID = @YearID,
		Semester = @Semester,
		TeachHour = @TeachHour,
		ResearchHour = @ResearchHour,
		SavePrev = @SavePrev,
		ResearchNow = @ResearchNow,
		ResearchContent = @ResearchContent,
		DecisionNo = @DecisionNo,
		TotalHour = @decTotalHour,
		SaveNext = @decSaveNext,
		LackHour = @decLackHour,
		UpdatedDate = GetDate(),
		UpdatedUser = @UpdatedUser
	Where TeachingTimeResearchID = @TeachingTimeResearchID

End

### 1. `TeachingTimeResearchEdit.ascx.cs` — `SaveData()`

Giống pattern `Poll/Plan/Edit`:

- **Thêm mới** (`TeachingTimeResearchID == null`) → gọi `objData.Add()`
- **Sửa** → gọi `objData.Update()`

### 2. `SimsObject/SIM_TeachingTimeResearch.cs`

- Xóa method `AddOrEdit()`
- Thêm `Add()` → SP `SIM_TeachingTimeResearch_Add`
- Thêm `Update()` → SP `SIM_TeachingTimeResearch_Update`

### 3. SQL mới

- `SIM_TeachingTimeResearch_Add.sql` — insert + kiểm tra trùng GV/năm/học kỳ
- `SIM_TeachingTimeResearch_Update.sql` — update + tính lại `TotalHour`, `SaveNext`, `LackHour`

`TeachingTimeResearchList.ascx` không cần sửa vì không có logic lưu.

**Việc cần làm thêm:**

1. Chạy 2 script SQL mới trên database.
2. Copy `SimsObject/SIM_TeachingTimeResearch.cs` vào project SimsObject, rebuild DLL và copy vào `bin`.
3. Nếu base class đã có sẵn `Add()`/`Update()` từ DCore codegen thì bỏ trùng ở một trong hai chỗ (base hoặc partial) để tránh lỗi compile.

/*

	Store: SIM_TeachingTimeResearch_EDIT
*/
ALTER proc [dbo].[SIM_TeachingTimeResearch_EDIT]
(
	@TeachingTimeResearchID bigint,
	@TeacherID nvarchar(200),
	@YearID int,
	@Semester int,
	@TeachHour decimal(18,2) = null,
	@ResearchHour decimal(18,2) = null,
	@SavePrev decimal(18,2) = null,
	@ResearchNow decimal(18,2) = null,
	@ResearchContent nvarchar(max) = null,
	@DecisionNo nvarchar(500) = null,
	@TotalHour decimal(18,2) = null,
	@SaveNext decimal(18,2) = null,
	@LackHour decimal(18,2) = null,
	@UpdatedUser nvarchar(50) = null
)
AS
Begin

	Declare @decTotalHour decimal(18,2)
	Declare @decSaveNext decimal(18,2)
	Declare @decLackHour decimal(18,2)

	If @TotalHour is null
		Set @decTotalHour = isnull(@SavePrev, 0) + isnull(@ResearchNow, 0)
	Else
		Set @decTotalHour = @TotalHour

	If @SaveNext is null or @LackHour is null
	Begin
		If @decTotalHour >= isnull(@ResearchHour, 0)
		Begin
			Set @decSaveNext = @decTotalHour - isnull(@ResearchHour, 0)
			Set @decLackHour = 0
		End
		Else
		Begin
			Set @decSaveNext = 0
			Set @decLackHour = isnull(@ResearchHour, 0) - @decTotalHour
		End
	End
	Else
	Begin
		Set @decSaveNext = @SaveNext
		Set @decLackHour = @LackHour
	End

	Update SIM_TeachingTimeResearch
	Set
		TeacherID = @TeacherID,
		YearID = @YearID,
		Semester = @Semester,
		TeachHour = @TeachHour,
		ResearchHour = @ResearchHour,
		SavePrev = @SavePrev,
		ResearchNow = @ResearchNow,
		ResearchContent = @ResearchContent,
		DecisionNo = @DecisionNo,
		TotalHour = @decTotalHour,
		SaveNext = @decSaveNext,
		LackHour = @decLackHour,
		UpdatedDate = GetDate(),
		UpdatedUser = @UpdatedUser
	Where TeachingTimeResearchID = @TeachingTimeResearchID

End
